Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center. EDSA corner Quezon Avenue. west Triangle. Quezon City http: dilg.gov.ph DILG Legal Opinion No. 17 S. 2016 HON. FERDINAND M. AMANTE, JR. City Mayor, Butuan City 0 1 APR 2016 Dear Hon. Amante, Jr.: 'I'his has reference to your letter dated 07 March 2016 seeking the Department's legal opinion regarding the propriety and legality of the intended mixed government- private offices and commercial uses of the two (2) parcels of land designated as the Butuan City Uptown Government Complex, subject of Presidential Proclamation No. 1059, dated 16 June 2015. under the local governme t's Public-Private Partnership Code (SP Ordinance No. 3905-2012). Particularly, you are seeking opinion as to "whether the City Government's plan Io embark on a PPP with a private proponent to develop the area into a modern Uptown Government Complex and offer the leasable premises for mixed government, ofiice and commercial uses, will not violate the condition imposed under Presidential Proclamation No. 1059. " As stated in your aforesaid letter, the subject Presidential issuance imposed the following as the sole condition for the transfer of/ the parcels of land to the City of Butuan, to wit: "'Ihe parcels ofland shall be transferred to the City Government of Butuan on the condition that the said parcels of land shall not be used for other than government offices, " (Italics and underscoring supplied) A prudent examination of the above-quoted proviso reveals that it is couched in a very restrictive and mandatory language, leaving PO other option but for its strict construction and interpretation. Considering that said proviso in the Presidential issuance is too specific as regards the altowable and intended use or purpose of the subject parcels of land, this Department is of the opinion that the same cannot be devoted to any other uses or purposes but specifically and exclusively for "government offices" only. Note must be made that the same issuance did not only provide as a condition that the use of the parcels of land be devoted solely for government uses pr purposes, which may admit of a more liberal interpretation, but that it specifically provided for "government offices. " Thus, it is clear that the intention behind the Presidential issuance

precludes any interpretation allowing any other u e of the properties, whether incidental or otherwise. Further, it is a settled rule in statutory construction 'that the word "shall" denotes the mandatoty character of the rule which ip the case at bar speaks of a condition. Ilence, it is without question that the language f the Presidential issuance in question mandatorily imposes the condition that the use or purpose of the parcels of land in dispute be exclusively devoted to gtvernment offi es. If the intendment is otherwise, the same Presidential issuance could have used words or phrases in the condition which can accommodate a more liberal interpretation thereo . From the föregoing, it is clear that your City's intended mixed. government-private offices and commercial uses of theptwo (ß) parcel of land designated as the Butuan City Uptown Government Complex, cannot be legally ndertaken, the same being violative of the sole condition imposed by Presidential Procla ation No. 1059, dated 16 June 2015. Thank you. V ry truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary - OUSLG 2016-0 -30-01529 Ll.LS:25 Copy furnished: REGIONAL DIRECIOR LILIBEI'II A. FAMACION DILG-Region XIII, 1559 Matimco Bldg.
